documentation.content: A backend route family has more than 15 server errors in a rolling 900-second window for 600 seconds. Route identity is method + route: the optional version and up to three complete lowercase path segments, stopping at the first invalid segment. All matching non-empty families page without a fixed route list. Status codes and revisions are summed, but families and methods are not. Follow https://github.com/BasedHardware/omi/blob/main/backend/docs/runbooks/backend-route-5xx.md. Lowercase slugs and some all-letter IDs can pass this shape-based normalization; see the runbook for cardinality limitations.

conditions.displayName: One route exceeds 15 5xx in 15 minutes for 10 minutes

conditionThreshold.filter: metric.type="logging.googleapis.com/user/backend_route_5xx" AND resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="backend" AND metric.labels.method != "" AND metric.labels.route != ""
